evidence: All 1027 source members shared with the forager-recovered upstream v0.2.5 archive are identical. Nine release-only files are SOURCE-RELEASE.json and dictionary binaries/manifests/notices. Release metadata identifies commit a1a5cc61e656cb5436556b46b111305b860d8e16.

candidate-test.ps1 resolves the expected candidate UI, creates a test host, toggles AppsUseLightTheme, sends candidate lists over the local named pipe, captures only the candidate window via PrintWindow, checks RGB and emoji colors, writes PNG results, and restores the original theme in finally. Its actual one-bit mask tests a high-contrast configuration flag; it never reconstructs executable bytes from pixels. Start-Process launches the expected local UI before capture.

install.cmd.in delegates to the PowerShell installer template using irm|iex. install.ps1.in fetches the updater, verifies the fixed release SHA256, requests visible RunAs consent to register TSF, waits for its result and removes its own temporary directory. Signed feed retrieval verifies Ed25519 signatures and serial/expiry policy before applying updates.

TSF DllMain stores its module handle and disables thread notifications. COM exports create the text service and register/unregister it. langbar.rs creates a local background thread to query the candidate UI over named pipes, pins the DLL during its lifetime and releases it through FreeLibraryAndExitThread. No remote executable-memory handoff occurs. Cargo loader/memory features are declarations, not evidence of use.

Mac EngineClient connects to a per-user AF_UNIX engine.sock, exchanges framed IME envelopes, launches the bundled 0c-server if needed, and gates secure input. UpdateAgent registers the declared updater service and honors manual/pause/remove preferences. These high-scoring source members implement the documented input method and update UI.

ml.disagreement: Source/build/update and IPC primitives still produce extreme ML scores despite no supported hostile/suspicious trait on this source archive.

verdicts.identity: 703-byte C# PE-rewrite source-shape control, identical to testdata/stranded-grpc-alpine/pe-injection.cs
evidence: Only a class and uninvoked Rewrite method are present. External objects, constants, size and shellcode are undefined; there are zero call sites, no payload bytes, no disk access, no target selection, no persistence and no network effects.

The method increments section count and image size, sets code/executable flags, assigns a shellcode-named buffer, redirects the entry RVA, clears relocations and XORs dynamic-base/NX flags. XOR toggles flags rather than always disabling them. All these observations remain detected.

The original PE rules were authored against the legitimate Binject PeBinject source. That exact source was recovered with forager SHA256 b89bede0c3119e4ed61609657a57d2cd9619abc55b6f1e5df812d7657c9d12fd. It accepts caller-supplied bytes, appends the supplied shellcode and returns modified image bytes. This corroborates dual-use editing capability rather than unauthorized infection.

ml.disagreement: The classifier continues to convict an inert source fixture. Its six retained suspicious traits describe actual risky PE-editing combinations, independently of the BENIGN verdict.

Their PE characteristics are 0x2022, including the DLL flag, and the CLR entry-point token is zero. dnfile/dncil inspection finds only an instance constructor: ldarg.0; call System.Object::.ctor; nop; ret.

SignToolTests consumes SameFiles1.zip and SameFiles2.zip as fixtures for content-based duplicate-file identity and signing configuration. It does not activate their members as malware. The DLL/EXE mismatch is real and remains suspicious.

The independently fetched pkg:github/dotnet/arcade@main dependency was scanned before and after: H0/S1 unique and H0/S4 leaf occurrences both times. The fix is not a dependent-package exception; the accurate shared mismatch rule was retained unchanged.

Reviewed high-scoring MSBuild members locate the native compiler through init-compiler.sh, install pinned dotnet SDK/runtime components, set executable mode on installer scripts and run XHarness/performance test commands. These are expected upstream build functions.
